The '''Tropical TV''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be purchased from the [[Island Trader]] for 30 [[Taro Root]]s on any day.

It functions identically to a normal television, allowing access to [[Television|TV channels]].

Players can view [[television]] programs by {{key|right-clicking}} on the Tropical TV.

{{History|1.5|Introduced.}}
